csv_project_name: Design for USH 141 C Green Bay Main Street Resurfacing
csv_agency: State of Wisconsin Dept of Trans Div Of Hwys
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Wisconsin , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to provide Design for Perpetuation project to repair 2.3 miles of concrete pavement on USH 141, IH 43 - Baird Street, within the city of Green Bay and the village of Bellevue in Brown County. Design concrete repair/replacement and potential grinding. Miscellaneous structure rehabilitation work will be performed to the box culvert C-05-0092 carrying USH 141 over the north branch of Willow Creek. 2) Perpetuation Standalone Curb Ramp Improvement Program (SCRIP) project to address curb ramps and cross walks on 2.3 miles of USH 141, IH 43 - Baird Street, within the city of Green Bay and the village of Bellevue in Brown County. Approximately 60 curb ramps will be evaluated and those that are identified as being out of compliance will be reconstructed to standard or documented as technically infeasible.3) Perpetuation project to resurface 1 mile of USH 141, Manitowoc Road - Lime Kiln Road, in the city of Green Bay and the village of Bellevue in Brown County. Safety improvements will be evaluated at 4 intersections. Approximately 20 curb ramps will be evaluated and those that are identified as being out of compliance will be reconstructed to standard or documented as technically infeasible. Spot repairs to curb & gutter and islands will be investigated.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering

services: Consulting design services including civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering for roadway perpetuation, ADA curb ramp improvements, intersection safety evaluation, and box culvert rehabilitation.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a roadway resurfacing and ADA curb ramp improvement project, which is only marginally aligned with sbp's core focus.
- Includes a structural component: rehabilitation of an existing box culvert, but this appears minor and not structurally complex.
- No indication of long spans, innovative structural systems, lightweight design, or architecturally demanding structures.
- Design services are included, which is positive, but the overall scope is dominated by highway and pavement work.

fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated in the tender notice.
